muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /ticks sse(Ticks(ctx))" -}}{{- .Result -}}{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"iter"
	"slices"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Server struct{}

// Ticks yields a fixed sequence; each yielded value renders one event.
func (Server) Ticks(ctx context.Context) iter.Seq[string] {
	return slices.Values([]string{"t1", "t2", "t3"})
}
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/ticks", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	want := "data: t1\n\ndata: t2\n\ndata: t3\n\n"
	if got := rec.Body.String(); !strings.Contains(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("body = %q, want one event per value in order: %q", got, want)
	}
}
